title: Date Night Board for Two
h1: Date Night Charcuterie Board for Two
seo_title: Date Night Charcuterie Board for Two: Shopping List & Plan
description: A date night charcuterie board for two: brie, aged Gouda, chèvre with truffle honey, prosciutto, bresaola, figs, strawberries, dark chocolate and honeycomb.
hook: Half portions, one good cheese at each end and a small board you both have to reach into: the classic date night board.
why: A date night board should be snug, not sparse: three cheeses, two meats and a handful of sweet things, on a board small enough that everything is within reach. Brie, a shard of aged Gouda and chèvre drizzled with truffle honey cover creamy, crunchy and tangy.
Silky prosciutto and lean, deep-red bresaola look beautiful together, and figs, strawberries, honeycomb and dark chocolate make it a dessert as well as a starter.

timeline.what: Take out the cheeses; chill the wine or sparkling.
Set the table and light a candle.
Build the board; drizzle the truffle honey.
Dim the lights; open the wine.

faq.q: What do you put on a date night charcuterie board?
faq.a: Two or three good cheeses (brie, aged Gouda, chèvre), prosciutto and bresaola, figs, strawberries, dark chocolate, honeycomb, fig jam and crostini.

faq.q: How much charcuterie for two people?
faq.a: About 3 to 4 oz of cheese and 1½ to 3 oz of meat per person if it's the main snack, less before dinner.

faq.q: What wine goes with a date night board?
faq.a: A dry sparkling wine, Pinot Noir or a light rosé all suit the creamy cheeses and the chocolate.
